name: kpred-desk
description: Knode swap desk: swap VHP for the desk's KOIN at 1:1 minus a 3% fee. The desk's VHP produces blocks, which refills its KOIN.

scripts.build: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 0 desk.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/make-abi.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node node_modules/@as-pect/cli/bin/asp.js --config as-pect.config.js
scripts.build:sim: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 1 desk.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/copy-sim.cjs && npm run build
